name: metrifi
description: One MetriFi sign-in connects Codex to the MetriFi platform (Site Builder, GEO AI-search visibility, and CRO analytics) and adds the MetriFi skills: client-report for auditing an institution's existing site, generate-claude-design-system, generate-claude-design-page and page-design-process for designing and building one, and the GEO experiment skills that run a campaign from research through to a reviewed client deliverable.

interface.shortDescription: One MetriFi sign-in to the MetriFi platform (Site Builder, GEO AI-search visibility, and CRO analytics) plus the MetriFi site-design skills. No token paste.
